}}'''Kert Wagoner''' is a man from the [[Two Rivers]] who followed [[Perrin Aybara]] as a soldier and who fought in the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kert Wagoner}}

==Activities==
Kert is in Perrin's camp, when Rand and Perrin are talking at the [[Field of Merrilor]], he asks Rand about the storms and is reassured by Rand's answer.

== Trivia ==
* Kert Wagoner is named for Kurt Wagoner, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
